## F — Seat adjustment and occupant protection
Research index: knowledge and continuation facts are in C and C2 for Seat adjustment and occupant protection. Each fact resolves to a single source page, with accepted identifiers preserved for downstream compilation.
VERIFY list:
- MT-sec04-COUNT: official question count unknown.
- MT-sec04-PASS: official passing standard unknown.
- MT-sec04-TIME: official time limit unknown.
- MT-sec04-EDITION: reconcile cover and back-cover revision statements.
- MT-sec04-CHILD-THRESHOLD: Page thirty says a child six years old and weighing less than sixty pounds in one paragraph, then up to age six and sixty pounds in another. Mandatory age/weight boundaries and combination need issuer clarification; no numeric child-seat trigger is asserted.
- MT-sec04-BELT-FINE: Page twenty-nine gives a monetary seatbelt penalty; verify current official penalty before asserting an amount.
- MT-sec04-CRASH-ANALOGIES: Page twenty-nine crash-speed, building-height and elephant analogy and page thirty adult-to-crash-force calculation lack traceable calculation context. Quantitative illustrations are withheld pending official evidence.
- MT-sec04-CARE-TIMING: Page twenty-nine first-hour care statement has no cited medical study. No clinical timing rule or survival prediction is asserted.
- MT-OCCUPANT-MARKET: market evidence missing.
- MT-OCCUPANT-TEARDOWN: competitor evidence missing.
Dynamic isolation: The child-restraint age-and-weight threshold is withheld because the page uses conflicting formulations; current monetary penalties and quantitative crash analogies also remain debt.
